title: ocimum nummularia
intro: Ocimum nummularia, commonly known as Silver-leaved Basil, is a species of plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain, fight infections, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Ocimum nummularia include analgesic, anti-spasmodic, and anti-convulsant effects, which may help to relieve pain, reduce muscle spasms, and prevent seizures. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may provide antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
